Tokyo's coffee neighbourhood, Kiyosumi-Shirakawa, wakes up late: Blue Bottle opens at 8:00. But you can still eat at 6:30 and be in Shibuya by 07:28. Here's how 👇

🛏️ Which side would you sleep on? Our pick is here 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kiyosumi-shirakawa-base-7am-start

We love this area for calm mornings by the Sumida River and the garden. The question is what happens when you need to leave at 7.

☕ BREAKFAST AT SEVEN

1️⃣ CLANN BY THE RIVER, on the 2nd floor of LYURO Tokyo Kiyosumi, lists hours from 7:00. Soup and bread breakfast, right on the river. Cashless only.

🚶 It is about 10 minutes on foot from Exit A3, so 7:00 breakfast means a train closer to 7:30.

🌿 A SLOW MORNING

2️⃣ Blue Bottle's flagship café here opens at 8:00. Kiyosumi Gardens opens at 9:00, ¥150.

💛 That is the morning people come here for, and worth keeping for at least one day.

🚇 A FIXED 7:00 DEPARTURE

3️⃣ Comfort Hotel Tokyo Kiyosumi Shirakawa is at Exit B1 and serves a free buffet from 6:30.

🚆 On our sample Wednesday the 07:05 Hanzomon Line train started at Kiyosumi-Shirakawa and reached Shibuya at 07:28. The 07:08 Oedo Line train started here too, Shinjuku at 07:40.

✅ OUR TAKE

Early starts? Sleep by the station and eat at 6:30. Leaving around 7:30? Walk to the river for CLANN. And keep one alarm-free morning for coffee at 8.
